verdicts.reason: A pulls the T's crossbar in from the right edge and stops the stem at about 80% height. That loses the original's bleed and leaves a dead blue band across the bottom third, and the headline block is undersized for the square, so the canvas feels half-empty. B keeps the crossbar bleeding off the right edge, as in the original, and sets larger, more legible type. Its flaws are a stem that still floats short of the bottom edge instead of bleeding, and an empty lower-left quadrant that makes the composition top-heavy.
